{{Top|leg}}
A '''jet-ball''' was a circular piece of sports equipment that was built with tiny [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] that enabled the ball to travel through the air at very fast speeds. Occasionally, a static discharge would build up on the surface of the jet-ball, causing it to crackle and glow with light.
